payload.body_you: You notice the effort {{holder1}} makes more easily. {{holder1}} remembers what you like, saves you a seat, checks in at the right time, or handles one small detail before it becomes another errand on your list. What matters is that {{holder1}} was paying attention. Being considered can feel just as meaningful as being celebrated.
payload.body_they: The effort you make may matter more to {{holder1}}. You remember what {{holder1}} likes, make room for them in the plan, check in after a long day, or take one small task off their list. {{holder1}} feels appreciated because you noticed what would make the day easier.
